limit.description:
Return only the top N players. Omit for the whole list.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 1500.

position.description:
Position. FLX is RB/WR/TE, IDP is DL/LB/DB, DST is team defense, ALL is the site's overall board.

Provider reference: allowed values ["QB", "RB", "WR", "TE", "K", "DST", "FLX", "IDP", "DL", "LB", "DB", "ALL"].

scoring.description:
Scoring: standard (non-PPR), half PPR, full PPR or TE premium. Default PPR.

Provider reference: allowed values ["STD", "HALF", "PPR", "TEP"]; default "PPR".

superflex.description: Superflex league values. Changes the overall order and tiers; positional projections stay the same.

200.description:
Draft Sharks rest-of-season rankings for one position from GET /ros-rankings/load-table (plus /load-rows past the first 250): rank, tiers, bye, remaining strength of schedule, projected games, injury risk, per-game median, floor, ceiling and consensus projections, and the site's 3D value.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `players` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bye_week` | number |  |
| `consensus_points` | number | Consensus points per game for the rest of the season. |
| `ds_value` | number | The site's 3D value, the rest-of-season sort key (can be negative). |
| `injury_risk` | number | Injury probability, percent. |
| `name` | string |  |
| `player_id` | number | Draft Sharks player id (team id for DST). |
| `pos_rank` | string | Positional rank label, for example RB1. |
| `position` | string | QB, RB, WR, TE, K, DST, DL, LB or DB; the rest-of-season ALL board also lists TQB and TK (team quarterback and team kicker). |
| `projected_ceiling` | number |  |
| `projected_floor` | number |  |
| `projected_games` | number | Games the player is projected to play. |
| `projected_points` | number | Draft Sharks median points per game for the rest of the season. |
| `rank` | number | Rank within the requested position, 1-based. |
| `rookie` | boolean |  |
| `strength_of_schedule` | number | Percent easier (+) or harder (-) than an average schedule; null when the site shows none. |
| `team` | string | Team abbreviation as the site writes it (JAC, LVR, WAS). |
| `tier` | number | Positional tier. |
| `tier_overall` | number | Tier on the overall board. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
